title: PUT /v0.1/spheres/{sphere}/public/{linkId}, and …/page
description: What the Obysphere now serves for a public link (spec/sphere-api.md section 11): the SHA-256 and size of the ciphertext it keeps, or of the page the owner's client uploaded, which that client checks against what /a/{linkId} serves. Comes with the feature artifacts.

link_id.description: The link's id, its owner's client's choice, unique on the server: /a/{linkId}.
